By way of this petition filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C., petitioner prays for grant of regular bail in case FIR No.02 dated 25.02.2023 registered under Sections 419 and 420 IPC at Police Station Cyber Crime Jind, District Jind.

sentences.text: It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is not named in the FIR; that case is triable by the Magistrate; that investigation is complete; that petitioner is in custody for the last four months and, therefore, he be allowed bail.
Learned State Counsel opposed the bail petition by pointing out that petitioner is involved in five more cases of the same nature.
As per the allegations, an amount of `2,98,188/- was withdrawn from the credit card of the complainant by way of cyber fraud.
During investigation, amount was found to have been transferred in the account of one Amit Kumar.
